طفل 5 سنوات يجيب بكلمات مفردة: اضطراب نطق. طفل 18 شهراً يقول «لا» فقط: إحالة.
signs.en:
AgeLanguage
0-1 monthResponds to touch and sounds (sensorimotor communication)
About 10 monthsMama/dada with meaning
After 123-5 words
1-5 yearsA two-year-old who does not talk or respond: report
6-12Uses logic
12-18Abstract thinking

A 5-year-old who answers in single words: speech disorder. An 18-month-old who says only "no": referral.

nursing.ar:
• المراهق: اسأل بعض الأسئلة دون الوالدين.
  • شجّع اتصاله بالأقران (أولوية): زيارات الأصدقاء ولقاء مراهقين بعلاج مماثل.
  • مراهق يرفض زيارة الزملاء: أولوية العزلة الاجتماعية.
  • فتاة 14 سنة بجر: اسمح بالتفاعل مع من هم في سنها وارتداء ملابسها.
nursing.en:
• Teenager: ask some questions without the parents present.
  • Encourage contact with peers (priority): visits from friends and meeting teenagers on similar treatment.
  • A teenager who refuses visits from classmates: social isolation is the priority.
  • A 14-year-old girl in traction: allow interaction with people her age and wearing her own clothes.

redflags.en:
Report
  • Two years old and does not talk or respond

teaching.en: • Talk to the child in simple language.

en: Two years old and not talking: report

q.en: When does a child say mama dada with meaning?

why.en: The correct answer is "10 months"; about 10 months.

why.ar: الإجابة الصحيحة «تشجيع زيارة الأصدقاء»؛ تجنب العزلة.
why.en: The correct answer is "Encourage visits from friends"; avoid isolation.

q.ar: طفل سنتين لا يتكلم أو يستجيب:
q.en: A two-year-old who does not talk or respond:

why.en: The correct answer is "Report"; a priority sign.

q.en: A 5-year-old who answers in single words:

why.en: The correct answer is "Speech disorder"; assess.

options.ar: ماما/دادا ويشد نفسه ويلتقط طعاماً صغيراً
options.en: Mama/dada, pulls to stand and picks up small food

why.ar: الإجابة الصحيحة «ماما/دادا ويشد نفسه ويلتقط طعاماً صغيراً» وفق ما شُرح في أقسام الدليل (العلامات والتمريض).
why.en: The correct answer is "Mama/dada, pulls to stand and picks up small food", as explained in the guide sections (signs and nursing).

why.ar: الإجابة الصحيحة «إحالة» وفق ما شُرح في أقسام الدليل (العلامات والتمريض).
why.en: The correct answer is "Referral", as explained in the guide sections (signs and nursing).
